result_text:
`InstrumentedModel.request(...)` no longer raises when tool definitions or other request parameters contain lone surrogates. The tests in `tests/models/test_instrumented.py` pass (45), including a new regression test. I didn't run the rest of the suite.

Both `gen_ai.tool.definitions` and `model_request_parameters` now go through `safe_to_json` in `pydantic_ai/_instrumentation.py`, instead of calling `to_json` directly. The lone surrogate is kept: parsing the attribute back gives a description equal to the original string. Ordinary text produces the same output as before.

`safe_to_json` now takes `object` instead of `Any` and otherwise behaves as before. Pyright reports no errors on `_instrumentation.py`.

The new test is `test_instrumented_model_tool_definitions_lone_surrogate`. It uses the `'get the weather before\udce4after'` description and checks the parsed `gen_ai.tool.definitions` list and `function_tools[0].name` in `model_request_parameters`.

The sandbox failed on the first command (bwrap couldn't mount `/proc`), so I ran everything with the sandbox disabled.
